description.narrative: The Aus4ASEAN Fellowships Investment supports industry influencers and thought leaders from across Southeast Asia to deepen their knowledge and networks in areas that reinforce the ASEAN Outlook on the Indo-Pacific and build lasting ASEAN-Australia connections. Fellowships are being delivered in two thematic cohorts (‘digital trade and inclusive digital economy’ and ‘sustainable energy transition and green skills’) and include an in-Australia component, an online component, a regional meeting with experts, and coaching. ‍ During the reporting period, the first cohort ('digital trade and inclusive digital economy') commenced in May 2025 and concluded the online and in-Australia components. Fellows explored how digital policy, inclusion, and innovation can shape more equitable and connected futures. Activities included sessions on AI, digital inclusion, e-commerce, women in tech and scam resilience, and site visits to leading organisations within Victoria’s start-up ecosystem. This is equipping the Fellows with practical skills and strategic insights to lead digital transformation in the region.

The Aus4ASEAN Fellowships, announced at the 2024 ASEAN-Australia Special Summit, are supporting up to 55 mid-level and senior industry professionals from the region to deepen their knowledge and networks in areas that reinforce the ASEAN Outlook on the Indo-Pacific and build lasting ASEAN-Australia connections. The Fellowships are being delivered in two thematic cohorts (‘digital trade and inclusive digital economy’ and ‘sustainable energy transition and green skills’) and include an in-Australia component, an online component, a regional meeting with experts, and coaching. The first cohort commenced in May 2025 with Fellows completing the in-Australia and online components during the reporting period. The second cohort will commence in September 2025. Australia’s initiatives announced at the 2024 ASEAN-Australia Special Summit, such as the Aus4ASEAN Fellowships, were welcomed in the Chairman’s Statement of the 2025 ASEAN Post-Ministerial Conference 10+1 Session.
